verdict.rationale: The enterprise page claims 'Programmatic queries via API,' but only as an enterprise integration with no public reference docs. The publicly documented programmatic surface is the hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp), whose deep-review, full-text Q&A, notes and library tools let agents drive the product. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt, so there is no evidence of a documented general-purpose public API. Missing for 10: publicly documented REST/HTTP API reference, OpenAPI spec, auth/rate-limit docs, self-serve (non-enterprise) API access, independent corroboration of API use.
